// Pure original-node trie/ABI fixture; no chain, wallet, RPC or live state.
package definition

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon/common"
	"github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon/common/trie"
	"github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon/common/types"
)

func TestSPVThreeRowWitnessCapture(t *testing.T) {
	var input struct {
		Batch  string `json:"batch_value_hex"`
		Record string `json:"record_value_hex"`
		Config string `json:"config_value_hex"`
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("spv_three_row_inputs.json")
	if err != nil || len(raw) > 16384 || json.Unmarshal(raw, &input) != nil {
		t.Fatal("bounded selected ABI inputs unavailable", err)
	}
	decode := func(text string) []byte {
		data, err := hex.DecodeString(text)
		if err != nil || len(data) == 0 || len(data) > 4096 {
			t.Fatal("invalid selected ABI bytes", err)
		}
		return data
	}
	values := [][]byte{decode(input.Batch), decode(input.Record), decode(input.Config)}
	var batch BatchEntry
	var domain DomainRecord
	var config DomainConfig
	if err := ABISettlement.UnpackVariable(&batch, BatchEntryVariableName, values[0]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("original BatchEntry ABI", err)
	}
	if err := ABISettlement.UnpackVariable(&domain, DomainRecordVariableName, values[1]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("original domainRecord ABI", err)
	}
	if err := ABISettlement.UnpackVariable(&config, domainConfigVariableName, values[2]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("original domainConfig ABI", err)
	}
	subkeys := [][]byte{
		(&BatchEntryKey{DomainId: 1, BatchId: 0}).Key(),
		(&DomainRecordKey{DomainId: 1}).Key(),
		getDomainConfigKey(1),
	}
	keys := make([][]byte, 3)
	paths := make([]trie.Path, 3)
	compact := trie.NewCompactTree()
	for i, key := range subkeys {
		keys[i] = common.JoinBytes([]byte{0x03}, types.SettlementContract.Bytes(), []byte{0x04}, key)
		if len(keys[i]) != []int{35, 27, 27}[i] {
			t.Fatal("full ledger key framing changed")
		}
		paths[i] = trie.Path(types.NewHash(keys[i]))
		compact.Insert(paths[i], values[i])
	}
	root, err := trie.RootOfLeaves(paths, values)
	if err != nil || root == types.ZeroHash || compact.Root() != root {
		t.Fatal("original-node root implementations disagree", err)
	}
	rows := make([]map[string]interface{}, 0, 4)
	for i, name := range []string{"batch_entry", "domain_record", "domain_config"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			present, value, encoded, err := trie.ProveByPath(paths, values, paths[i])
			if err != nil || !present || !bytes.Equal(value, values[i]) {
				t.Fatal("original selected proof unavailable", err)
			}
			ok, err := trie.VerifyProofByPath(root, paths[i], value, encoded)
			if err != nil || !ok {
				t.Fatal("original path-native proof comparison", err)
			}
			changed := append([]byte(nil), value...)
			changed[0] ^= 1
			if ok, _ := trie.VerifyProofByPath(root, paths[i], changed, encoded); ok {
				t.Fatal("different value retained membership")
			}
			wrong := root
			wrong[0] ^= 1
			if ok, _ := trie.VerifyProofByPath(wrong, paths[i], value, encoded); ok {
				t.Fatal("different root retained membership")
			}
			path := types.Hash(paths[i])
			rows = append(rows, map[string]interface{}{
				"name": name, "present": present, "ledger_key_hex": hex.EncodeToString(keys[i]),
				"path_hex": path.String(), "value_hex": hex.EncodeToString(value),
				"proof_hex": hex.EncodeToString(encoded), "altered_root_and_value_refused": true,
			})
		})
	}
	t.Run("absent_batch", func(t *testing.T) {
		key := common.JoinBytes([]byte{0x03}, types.SettlementContract.Bytes(), []byte{0x04},
			(&BatchEntryKey{DomainId: 1, BatchId: 1}).Key())
		path := types.NewHash(key)
		present, value, encoded, err := trie.ProveByPath(paths, values, trie.Path(path))
		if err != nil || present || len(value) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("separate absence proof unavailable", err)
		}
		ok, err := trie.VerifyAbsenceByPath(root, trie.Path(path), encoded)
		if err != nil || !ok {
			t.Fatal("original path-native absence comparison", err)
		}
		rows = append(rows, map[string]interface{}{
			"name": "absent_batch", "present": false, "ledger_key_hex": hex.EncodeToString(key),
			"path_hex": path.String(), "value_hex": "", "proof_hex": hex.EncodeToString(encoded),
		})
	})
	if len(rows) != 4 || batch.FinalizeAtHeight < batch.SubmittedAtHeight {
		t.Fatal("incomplete selected mathematical fixture")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]interface{}{
		"format":   "selected-node-three-row-witness/v1",
		"scope":    "SYNTHETIC_THREE_LEAF_TREE_NO_HEADER_OR_NETWORK_ACCEPTANCE",
		"root_hex": root.String(), "domain_id": 1, "batch_id": 0,
		"settlement_address_hex":              hex.EncodeToString(types.SettlementContract.Bytes()),
		"original_trie_implementations_agree": true, "rows": rows,
		"stored_submission_height": batch.SubmittedAtHeight, "stored_finalize_height": batch.FinalizeAtHeight,
		"current_withdrawal_delay":                        config.WithdrawalDelay,
		"stored_delay_equals_selected_current_config":     batch.FinalizeAtHeight-batch.SubmittedAtHeight == config.WithdrawalDelay,
		"source_fixture_values_are_one_original_snapshot": false,
		"node_chain_wallet_RPC_or_transactions_started":   false,
	})
	if err != nil || len(data) > 32768 {
		t.Fatal("bounded trace encoding", err)
	}
	t.Logf("SPV_THREE_ROW_TRACE %s", data)
}
